# doom-cli

> Unified cross-platform CLI tool, curated engine configurations, and launcher presets for classic Doom source
> ports (DSDA-Doom, UZDoom).

## Overview

`github.com/lock14/doom-cli` provides a static, zero-dependency Go CLI (`doom`) that automates Doom source port
management, engine configuration deployment with display auto-detection, Steam and GOG game file discovery,
multi-mirror community megawad downloading, and interactive terminal launching across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Quick start

```bash
# Automated 4-step core setup (configs, engines, soundfont, and Steam or GOG Doom IWADs)
doom setup

# Optional: include community megawads and non-Doom id Tech 1 games during setup
doom setup --wads all --games heretic,hexen

# Play The Ultimate Doom immediately, fetch a megawad, or specify any WAD preset and engine flags
doom
doom wads fetch eviternity-ii
doom eviternity-ii
doom "Eviternity" -e dsda-doom
doom "Ancient Aliens" -skill 4

# Interactive terminal WAD browser with fuzzy search and preview pane
doom wads
```

## CLI command tree

- `doom [wad] [flags]`: Direct game launcher (defaults to *The Ultimate Doom* when no `<wad>` argument is given),
  accepting preset IDs, unquoted multi-word WAD names (`doom Doom II`), Roman or Arabic numerals (`doom doom2`,
  `doom 2`, `doom sigil2`), WAD stems and filenames (`doom av`, `doom plutonia`, `doom sunlust.wad`), and multi-word
  acronyms (`doom btsx1`, `doom d2twid`, `doom nrftl`), and supporting `--engine` (`-e`), `--dry-run`, and pass-through
  engine arguments (such as `doom -skill 4 -warp 1 1` and `+map E1M1`).
- `doom wads [--all]`: Opens the interactive TUI WAD browser powered by Bubble Tea (showing installed presets by
  default, or the full curated catalog with `--all` or `F3` and `Ctrl+T`).
- `doom wads list [--all]`: Lists installed presets by default (or all curated and custom presets with `--all`), engine
  assignments, genre, difficulty, quality rating, and on-disk readiness (`[✓ Ready]` or `[✗ Missing]`).
- `doom wads show <name>`: Displays resolved game, launch configuration, genre, difficulty, quality rating,
  `Launch Cmd:` preview, sources, links, and file availability.
- `doom wads fetch <name[,name...]|all>`: Downloads and extracts SHA-256 verified community megawads from idgames
  mirrors and extracts missing commercial IWADs or optional assets (`idkfa 2024.wad`) from local Steam and GOG
  libraries (`--games` scopes `all` to include optional non-Doom games).
- `doom wads uninstall <name[,name...]>`: Deletes preset-exclusive PWAD, PK3, DeHackEd, companion `.txt`, and `.bak.*`
  files from primary `wads-dir` while protecting base IWADs, shared files, and secondary read-only `wads-dirs`.
- `doom wads scan [--games <list|all>]`: Auto-discovers and imports official Steam and GOG commercial IWADs and
  expansions (Doom plus installed optional games by default, or explicit `--games`), and synthesizes `idkfa 2024.wad`
  from `extras.wad`.
- `doom wads add <name>`: Adds a custom WAD or preset to `catalog.d/preset.<id>.json`.
- `doom wads set <name>`: Configures per-WAD overrides in `catalog.d/override.preset.<id>.json`.
- `doom wads reset <name>`: Clears persistent launch overrides for a WAD.
- `doom wads remove <name>`: Removes a custom preset from the user catalog.
- `doom wads lint [root]`: Validates curated and user entity files, schema invariants, and `README.md` parity.
- `doom wads build [root]`: Hidden maintainer command that synchronizes curated `catalog/*.json` preset table into
  `README.md`.
- `doom engines`: Opens the interactive TUI engine manager on TTY terminals (or lists engines on non-TTY stdout).
- `doom engines list`: Lists all configured engines (built-in and custom) and checks binary paths.
- `doom engines install [engine|all]`: Downloads portable engine binaries (`uzdoom`, `dsda-doom`, or custom recipes),
  deploys engine `.cfg` templates, and installs the Roland SC-55 SoundFont (`GeneralUser-GS.sf2`).
- `doom engines add <name>`: Registers a custom source port engine in `catalog.d/engine.<id>.json`.
- `doom engines set <name>`: Configures per-engine overrides in `catalog.d/override.engine.<id>.json`.
- `doom engines reset <name>`: Clears persistent overrides for an engine.
- `doom engines remove <name>`: Removes a custom engine from the user catalog.
- `doom engines cfg [diff|install|sync]`: Inspects or deploys curated engine `.cfg` templates with native display
  auto-detection and timestamped backups (`sync` is a hidden maintainer command).
- `doom config`: Opens the interactive TUI CLI settings editor on TTY terminals (or displays active settings on
  non-TTY stdout).
- `doom config show`: Displays effective CLI settings (`config` or `default`) and source annotations.
- `doom config get [key]`: Retrieves an effective configuration value (`theme`, `nerd-fonts`, `wads-dir`, `wads-dirs`,
  `bin-dir`, `soundfonts-dir`), or shows all settings when no key is specified.
- `doom config set <key> <val>`: Sets a persistent configuration value in `config.json`.
- `doom config themes`: Lists built-in and custom JSON color themes with ANSI color swatches.
- `doom setup`: Turnkey 4-step core setup (configs, engines, SoundFont, and Steam or GOG Doom IWADs), with optional
  `--wads <none|all|names>` for community megawads and `--games <list|all>` for optional non-Doom id Tech 1 games.
- `doom completion <shell>`: Generates shell autocompletion for bash, zsh, fish, or powershell.
- `doom skill [install|uninstall]`: Prints the embedded `doom-cli` Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`) to `stdout`, or installs and
  uninstalls `<skills-dir>/doom-cli/SKILL.md` across `agents`, `antigravity`, `claude`, `codex`, `cursor`, `gemini`, or
  explicit `--dir <path>` targets (`--force` overwrites with a timestamped backup).

## CLI flags and environment variables

Settings resolve in two-tier precedence order (`config.json` takes precedence over platform defaults):

- Subcommand flags: `--engine` (`-e`) and `--dry-run` on root `doom`; `--all` on `doom wads` and `doom wads list`;
  `--engine` (`-e`), `--complevel`, `--engine-args`, `--files`, `--args`, and `--iwad` on `doom wads add` and
  `doom wads set` (plus `--include-file` and `--exclude-file` on `doom wads set`); `--games` on `doom setup`,
  `doom wads scan`, and `doom wads fetch`; `--wads` on `doom setup`; `--force` on `doom setup`, `doom wads fetch`,
  `doom wads scan`, and `doom engines install`.
- Environment variables: `DOOM_CONFIG_DIR` overrides the `doom-cli` configuration directory (which holds `config.json`,
  `catalog.d/`, and `themes/`), alongside standard OS directory variables (`XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`, `HOME`,
  `LOCALAPPDATA`, `USERPROFILE`).

## Architecture and modular packages

- `embed.go`: Single root `embed.FS` embedding `catalog/*.json`, `configs/dsda-doom/dsda-doom.cfg`,
  `configs/uzdoom/autoexec.cfg`, and `skills/doom-cli/SKILL.md`.
- `catalog/`: Per-entity curated JSON files (`engine.<id>.json`, `preset.<id>.json`).
- `configs/`: Curated source port configuration templates (`configs/dsda-doom/dsda-doom.cfg` and
  `configs/uzdoom/autoexec.cfg`) with runtime placeholder tokens.
- `skills/doom-cli/`: Portable player-facing Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`) embedded into the `doom` binary and installed via
  `doom skill install`.
- `cmd/doom/`: Modular Cobra CLI commands:
  - `main.go`: Entrypoint, root direct game launcher (`doom [wad] [flags]`), and path helpers.
  - `games.go`: Game-scope (`--games`), megawad selection (`--wads`), preset target list, and missing-argument hint
    helpers (`exactArgsWithHint`).
  - `wads.go`: `doom wads` interactive TUI browser and subcommands (`list`, `show`, `fetch`, `uninstall`, `scan`, `add`,
    `set`, `reset`, `remove`, `lint`, and hidden `build`).
  - `engines.go`: `doom engines` interactive TUI engine manager and subcommands (`list`, `install`, `add`, `set`,
    `reset`, `remove`, and `cfg` with `install`, `diff`, and hidden `sync`).
  - `config.go`: `doom config` interactive TUI settings editor and subcommands (`show`, `get`, `set`, `themes`).
  - `setup.go`: `doom setup` automated turnkey workflow.
  - `skill.go`: `doom skill` embedded `SKILL.md` `stdout` emitter, cross-agent installer, and uninstaller.
- `internal/catalog/`: Runtime two-layer entity catalog, game inference and library scoping, store operations, tiered
  query normalization, multi-root file and alias resolution, and CP437 decoding (`entity.go`, `games.go`, `codec.go`,
  `loader.go`, `query.go`, `store.go`, `resolve.go`, `decode.go`).
- `internal/config/`: Cross-platform path resolution adhering to XDG, Library, and AppData (`paths.go`), plus
  settings-only `config.json` and two-tier provenance helpers (`settings.go`).
- `internal/display/`: Native display resolution and refresh rate auto-detection.
- `internal/engine/`: Declarative source port binary installation (`installer.go`, `macapp.go`), launch argument
  synthesis (`PrepareLaunch`), and zero-I/O command preview formatting (`FormatLaunchPreview` in `runner.go`).
- `internal/fsutil/`: Atomic file writes with timestamped backups, SHA-256 verified HTTP downloads (`DownloadVerified`
  and `UserAgent`), and path-containment helpers (`fsutil.go`).
- `internal/portcfg/`: Embedded source port configuration template rendering, diffing, atomic backup deployment, and
  maintainer reverse synchronization (`render.go`, `deploy.go`, `sync.go`).
- `internal/repolint/`: Maintainer catalog schema and invariant linter, documentation linter, and `README.md` preset
  table synchronizer (`lint_catalog.go`, `lint_docs.go`, `readme.go`).
- `internal/steam/`: Multi-library `libraryfolders.vdf` parsing (`vdf.go`), catalog-driven game file extraction
  prioritizing `rerelease/` candidates over `base/` (`discover.go`), and streaming `idkfa 2024.wad` soundtrack synthesis
  from `extras.wad` (`idkfa.go`).
- `internal/tui/`: Interactive Bubble Tea launcher (`launcher.go`, `options.go`, `options_state.go`, `config_view.go`,
  `config_actions.go`, `config_tabs.go`, `layout.go`, `render.go`, `modals.go`, `menu.go`, `theme.go`,
  `builtin_themes.go`).
- `internal/wad/`: Multi-mirror SHA-256 verified downloader (`DownloadAll`, `DownloadSelected`), Zip Slip hardened
  extractor, embedded `DEHACKED` lump extractor, ranked `.txt` README extractor with `<primaryStem>.txt` fallback
  normalization, safe preset PWAD uninstaller (`UninstallPreset`), and SoundFont installer (`downloader.go`,
  `extract.go`, `uninstall.go`, `soundfont.go`).
- `internal/wadfmt/`: Shared binary Doom `IWAD` and `PWAD` lump directory reader, lump extractor, streaming `PWAD`
  builder, and serializer (`wadfmt.go`).
- `.agents/`: Glob-scoped domain rules (`.agents/rules/catalog-curation.md`, `.agents/rules/documentation-style.md`,
  `.agents/rules/monospace-tui.md`) and `mono-tui v0.2.5` design and audit skills (`.agents/skills/mono-tui-design/`,
  `.agents/skills/mono-tui-audit/`).

## Key design invariants

- **Single source of truth**: Curated engines and presets are defined one-entity-per-file in `catalog/*.json`, with
  user entities and overrides layered from `<ConfigDir>/catalog.d/*.json`.
- **Catalog-driven WAD aliases and Steam synthesis**: Alternate filename stems (`files[].aliases`) are declared once in
  `catalog/preset.<id>.json` and `<ConfigDir>/catalog.d/*.json`; `catalog.DirIndex` and `steam.DefaultTargetPatterns()`
  synthesize their lookup tables directly from the catalog alongside normalized filename matching
  (`catalog.NormalizeFilename`) and preset query normalization (`catalog.NormalizePresetQuery`).
- **Portability**: Configuration templates use `__RESOLUTION__`, `__REFRESH_RATE__`, and `__SOUNDFONT__` placeholders.
- **Destructive safety**: Atomic writes (`writeReaderTempAndRename`) and non-clobbering timestamped backups
  (`.bak.<timestamp>`, retaining at most `MaxBackupsPerFile = 3` per file and cleaning up orphaned `.bak.*` files via
  `fsutil.RemoveBackups` on entity or override deletion and `doom engines cfg sync`) are created across all CLI and
  in-TUI (`Ctrl+S` and `Ctrl+R`) configuration writes before modifying existing user files.
- **Archive and download security**: Zip Slip and path traversal prevention via `fsutil.CleanRel` and
  `fsutil.SafeJoin`, bounded extraction (`fsutil.WriteLimitedReaderAtomic`), HTTPS-to-HTTP redirect downgrade rejection,
  mandatory `sha256` digests on curated preset sources and pinned `GeneralUser-GS.sf2`, and streaming SHA-256
  verification via `fsutil.DownloadVerifiedContext` (`fsutil.UserAgent` `"doom-cli/2.0"`).
- **Strict line length (120 columns)**: Code enforced at 120 columns via `revive.toml` and `.editorconfig`.
